entry.name: jit.movie
entry.description: The jit.movie object plays and manipulates movie files. It comes in two forms: jit.movie, which outputs matrices, and jit.gl.movie, which outputs OpenGL textures. The OpenGL version is recommended for smoother playback and better performance.

attributes.name: seamless_loopcount
attributes.description: Number of instances to add to the seamlesscomposition (default = 32). Seamless mode looping enables an avf only feature where the entire file is addednumber of times to a virtual media composition. When enabled, looping media should exhibit less of a playback stutter when the playhead returns to the start of the file. This mode only allows forward playback looping of the entire file (are ignored), and is geared more towards temporal compression codec playback, such as h264. Increasing this value adds more instances to the composition, but may impact load time and memory usage.

messages.name: cancelframedump
messages.description: Stops the frame dump process. See.

messages.description: Jump to a frame number. See the above Discussion for information on usingwith this message.

messages.name: frame_coarse
messages.digest: Jump to a frame number (inaccurate but fast)

messages.name: framedump
messages.description: Commences a framedump, in which the movie will start from a frame specified by(the default is 0) and automatically output frames in sequence (noormessage is necessary) up to the frame specified by, skippingframes between each frame. The default values are 0 for the start frame, and the total framecount of the movie for the end frame. The defaultvalue is 1.During operation, the messageis sent out the right outlet before each frame has been output. When finished, the messageis output.

messages.name: jump
messages.digest: Jump to a relative movie frame
messages.description: Jump to a relative movie frame. See the above Discussion for information on usingwith this message.

messages.name: jump_coarse
messages.digest: Jump to a relative movie frame (inaccurate but fast)

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Read a movie from a disk file/URL/clipboard
messages.description: Reads a movie from a disk file, URL or the clipboard. If no argument is present a file selection dialog will be presented to choose a file. If the argument is parseable as a URL, the object will attempt to load a movie from that location. Otherwise, an argument is assumed to be a local file name.Ifis enabled, the movie will begin playing at once.

messages.name: start
messages.description: Starts movie playback at the currentfrom the current time value specified by.
